The Router was not lenient; it appropriately marked features as 'false' even when generic similarities (like 'elongated body') existed, prioritizing species-specific traits.

The topology auditor found no structural melting (mask confidence 0.98), and the perceptual auditor found no graphic distortions. Thus, the only major 'artifact' is the semantic mismatch itself.
